page: Amazon Web Services m8in.metal-48xl is a bare-metal, general-purpose server powered by Intel x86_64 processors. It delivers 96 physical cores and 192 virtual CPUs with dedicated allocation operating at a base frequency of 3.9 GHz. Operating as a bare-metal instance, it grants non-virtualized access directly to the physical compute resources, eliminating hypervisor overhead.

The system provides 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing a balanced memory-to-vCPU allocation of 4.0 GB per virtual core. It does not include integrated local disk storage, depending on network-attached storage volumes for persistence. The platform incorporates a 300 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, designed to facilitate high data throughput across distributed nodes.

Given its high vCPU count, balanced RAM profile, and rapid network interconnect, m8in.metal-48xl is structured for multi-threaded enterprise applications, distributed compute jobs, container fleets, and network-intensive workloads. The absence of local disk drives requires architectural reliance on external storage infrastructure for all persistent I/O.
